• PULL OFF the power switch.

a known good battery.
• PUSH ON the power switch.
• Does the VTM display .8.8.8.8 and
then change to ----?
YES

• Check the vehicle battery electrolyte level.
• Clean vehicle battery terminals.
• Check vehicle battery specific gravity
(para. 4-79).
• Charge vehicle battery (TM 9-6140-200-14).
• Return to step 1.
• If problem repeats, look for broken or loose
connections in DCA wiring from battery or in
cable W1.
